profile: Jazz Pharmaceuticals is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on medicines for rare diseases and patients with limited treatment options. Its portfolio includes therapies for epilepsies, cancers and sleep disorders, including Xywav, Epidiolex, Ziihera, Modeyso, Zepzelca and Rylaze. The company develops therapies through research and development programs and markets approved medicines to patients and healthcare providers in multiple countries.
